programme.title: 空中翱翔 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍。

programme.title: 獮猴島 #3 英普
programme.desc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發。目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動。熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛。

programme.title: 深潛北美 #1
programme.desc: 繫緊安全帶,一場令人血脈賁張的探險即將展開!莉茲以陸、海、空三種方式穿梭,只為拜訪阿拉斯加最荒僻遙遠之地,與當地野生動物相見歡。一窺北冰洋底下的神祕聲響,在科學家的陪同下傾聽水下居民的低語,與北極熊共食一餐,再與白頭海鵰一同在大自然中尋覓腐食殘骸。

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #2 英普
programme.desc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫。從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害。

programme.title: 野獸絕地求生記 #3 英普
programme.desc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師。跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術。然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧。

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食。在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義。

programme.desc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發。目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動。熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛。

programme.title: 深潛北美 #1
programme.desc: 繫緊安全帶,一場令人血脈賁張的探險即將展開!莉茲以陸、海、空三種方式穿梭,只為拜訪阿拉斯加最荒僻遙遠之地,與當地野生動物相見歡。一窺北冰洋底下的神祕聲響,在科學家的陪同下傾聽水下居民的低語,與北極熊共食一餐,再與白頭海鵰一同在大自然中尋覓腐食殘骸。

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #2 英普
programme.desc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫。從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害。

programme.title: 野獸絕地求生記 #3 英普
programme.desc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師。跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術。然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧。

programme.title: 非洲隱世國度 #1
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片觀察德拉肯斯堡山脈上野生動物的生態。我們會看到生物如何在頂峰到山下起伏的草原等無情的地貌中生存。

programme.title: 非洲隱世國度 #2
programme.desc: 南非雲山上的古老動植物一直引來人們無限遐想。那裡由天氣主宰並受入侵者威脅,但這些山脈不僅是現代生態的避難所,也能讓我們一窺過去旳面貌。

programme.title: 野外紀事 #4 英普
programme.desc: 從夏季融化的北極冰層,至到達阿拉斯加旅程盡頭的紅鮭覓食狂潮,於7月見證地球上一些最戲劇性的自然變化。

programme.title: 獮猴島 #3 英普
programme.desc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發。目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動。熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛。

programme.title: 野狗: 與族群一起奔跑 #2
programme.desc: 氣溫上升意味著水越來越少,並使得大地充滿炎熱感。曼茲族群必須與捕食性動物比鄰而立,依靠剩餘的珍貴水域補充水分。與維卡群一起狩獵,餵養幼崽,並觀察鶴群如何在各種困難中茁壯成長。

programme.title: 獮猴島 #3 英普
programme.desc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發。目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動。熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛。

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛。觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆。

programme.title: 成為大象: 瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長。與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲。

programme.title: 成為大象: 瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻。歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員: 一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安。

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #3 英普
programme.desc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢、還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅。

programme.title: 野獸絕地求生記 #4 英普
programme.desc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人。一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動。

programme.title: 城市野生拯救隊 #12
programme.desc: 這部12集的紀錄片系列將顯示哪些動物居住在城市中,以及牠們遇到了甚麼麻煩。當牠們需要幫助時,一隊拯救隊將會出動。每年有成千上萬的動物獲得新生,只因志願者和專業人士一同為熱愛的大自然出力。

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #5 英普
programme.desc: 野狗群的世界正在面對一場巨變,他們豐富的狩獵地正受到斑點鬣狗群的威脅。脆弱的狗寶寶已開始挨餓,因為無情的獵食者對手偷走了他們的食物,最終還突擊他們的棲身地。

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #6 英普
programme.desc: 對獅子來說,水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐,但同時也是危險的獵物。與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛,並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧,他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動。

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​觀看初學者第一次躍入空中的瞬間,就像一隻安地斯神鷹必須先去飛行學校接受訓練,然後才有可能展開雙翼翱翔。遇見那些沒有羽毛卻能高飛的奇特傢伙,並驚嘆遊隼高速俯衝捕捉獵物的驚人速度,也讚嘆牠下墜時抓取獵物的猛烈迅捷。

programme.title: 非洲隱世國度 #1

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #1 英普
programme.desc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源。親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥、螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘、以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈。

programme.title: 野獸絕地求生記 #2 英普
programme.desc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如。了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手。

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #5 英普
programme.desc: 野狗群的世界正在面對一場巨變,他們豐富的狩獵地正受到斑點鬣狗群的威脅。脆弱的狗寶寶已開始挨餓,因為無情的獵食者對手偷走了他們的食物,最終還突擊他們的棲身地。

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #6 英普
programme.desc: 對獅子來說,水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐,但同時也是危險的獵物。與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛,並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧,他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動。

programme.title: 野外紀事 #3 英普
programme.desc: 在北半球觀察夏季來臨,靠近赤道的地區進入雨季,而南非則變得乾旱,這使生物的數量變得懸殊。

programme.title: 非洲隱世國度 #1
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片觀察德拉肯斯堡山脈上野生動物的生態。我們會看到生物如何在頂峰到山下起伏的草原等無情的地貌中生存。

programme.title: 非洲隱世國度 #2
programme.desc: 南非雲山上的古老動植物一直引來人們無限遐想。那裡由天氣主宰並受入侵者威脅,但這些山脈不僅是現代生態的避難所,也能讓我們一窺過去旳面貌。

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #1 英普
programme.desc: 見證鬥士們如何在非洲大草原的旱季中爭奪水源和其他珍貴資源。親眼目擊獅子和大象為爭奪地盤的激烈爭鬥、螞蟻襲擊白蟻丘、以及蜜獾與毒蛇聯袂上演的危險探戈。

programme.title: 野狗: 與族群一起奔跑 #1
programme.desc: 讓我們一起瞭解這三個族群吧: 在鬱鬱蔥蔥的中心地帶活動的大型曼茲族群,荒地的卡庫裡族群,以及生活在公園邊緣的小型鸛群。聆聽朱爾茲講述它們在這個成敗攸關的賽季中的勝利和失敗事蹟。

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在半空中善於抓獵的飛行者一起出獵,觀看敏捷的帝王蜻蜓完成蛻變的過程,欣賞倉鴞悄然無聲靠近獵物的潛行方式,並捕捉一隻流浪的蠑螈縱身一躍跳入深淵的驚險飛躍。

programme.title: 獮猴島 #3 英普
programme.desc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發。目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動。熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛。

programme.title: 深潛北美 #1
programme.desc: 繫緊安全帶,一場令人血脈賁張的探險即將展開!莉茲以陸、海、空三種方式穿梭,只為拜訪阿拉斯加最荒僻遙遠之地,與當地野生動物相見歡。一窺北冰洋底下的神祕聲響,在科學家的陪同下傾聽水下居民的低語,與北極熊共食一餐,再與白頭海鵰一同在大自然中尋覓腐食殘骸。

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #2 英普
programme.desc: 拜訪澳洲最狡猾的鬥士和他們驚人的武器庫。從袋鼠的致命拳擊和紅背蜘蛛精密設計的陷阱,暸解他們如何運用這些必殺技擊退敵人,同時應對氣候變化的侵害。

programme.title: 野獸絕地求生記 #3 英普
programme.desc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師。跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術。然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧。

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與那些在空中交配遊戲中勝出的動物碰面,與一隻正調製專屬的愛情藥水蜜蜂一起起飛。觀看一隻飛蜥為了抵禦對手而展翼滑翔,並見證一對日本丹頂鶴透過優雅的雙人舞姿締結一生的羈絆。

programme.title: 成為大象: 瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長。與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲。

programme.title: 成為大象: 瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻。歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員: 一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安。

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #3 英普
programme.desc: 齊來為年輕的格鬥士們鼓掌,並親眼見證他們在美洲茂密的熱帶森林中奮力拼搏!然後退後一步,觀察一隻毒箭蛙發動絕活攻勢、還有美洲豹和凱門鱷爭奪地盤,以及見證一隻飢餓的長鼻狸與猛蜘蛛的邂逅。

programme.title: 野獸絕地求生記 #4 英普
programme.desc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人。一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動。

programme.title: 獮猴島 #3 英普
programme.desc: 當街頭部族發現深山部族侵入他們的領地後,爭戰一觸即發。目擊馬特諾爾糟糕的育兒技巧,並見證具領袖野心的阿吉特如何展開行動。熱浪來襲,迫使大家在森林中共享資源,緩和衝突氣氛。

programme.title: 深潛北美 #1
programme.desc: 繫緊安全帶,一場令人血脈賁張的探險即將展開!莉茲以陸、海、空三種方式穿梭,只為拜訪阿拉斯加最荒僻遙遠之地,與當地野生動物相見歡。一窺北冰洋底下的神祕聲響,在科學家的陪同下傾聽水下居民的低語,與北極熊共食一餐,再與白頭海鵰一同在大自然中尋覓腐食殘骸。

programme.title: 野外紀事 #5 英普
programme.desc: 環遊世界去察看另一個季節性轉變。北半球踏入秋天,在澳洲見證一次重生,湯加溫暖的熱帶海域充滿交配的座頭鯨。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想。茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然。例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #6
programme.desc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯。來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事。是時候告別韋札的家人。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #1
programme.desc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生動物。冬天帶來嚴苛的風暴、苦難和衝突,大多數動物都要為生存而戰。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #2
programme.desc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然。在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸。一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想。茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然。例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #6
programme.desc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯。來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事。是時候告別韋札的家人。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #1
programme.desc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生動物。冬天帶來嚴苛的風暴、苦難和衝突,大多數動物都要為生存而戰。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #1
programme.desc: 冬季的結束預示世上最大型又瘋狂的覓食潮來臨,大型海洋獵食者瞄準在阿拉斯加灣尋求庇護的數百萬條魚。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #2
programme.desc: 隨著春季來臨,日照變長,氣溫上升。不過,阿拉斯加只有短暫的春季。動物只有兩個月時間來覓食和組織家庭,還要避開獵食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #3
programme.desc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季。這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞台。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #1
programme.desc: 文拿與朋友莉莉星和蘿拉馬拉諾一起串餐廳,沉浸在植物性飲食中,法式糕點、五香「牛肉」炸角、泰式「雞」翼和燒「牛扒」。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #2
programme.desc: 多元化的大廚們製作垂涎欲滴的素餃子、炸「雞」三文治和越南「鮎魚」;文拿尋找龍蝦蘑菇並參觀美國最古老的豆腐廠。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #3
programme.desc: 文拿探索他加拿大的「後院」,發現美味的素壽司、開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #1
programme.desc: 祖拜登於2021年1月20日就任美國第46任總統,承諾在分裂的時代後團結和鎮靜,目標是「恢復美國魂」。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #2
programme.desc: 當川普的總統任期(2017-2021)在一片爭議和社會變革中過渡,對國家和世界產生了良久影響。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #3
programme.desc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望、正義、寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #9
programme.desc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #1
programme.desc: 隨著日照越短、天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反。在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓。對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #4
programme.desc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #5
programme.desc: 透過檔案錄像見證柯林頓總統被彈劾當天的故事。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #6
programme.desc: 見證美國南部和中西部如何在短短18小時內遭受148個龍捲風肆虐。

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #4
programme.desc: 從數千英尺高空探索西開普省迷人的海岸線、注目的山脈和多樣性的大都會。

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #5
programme.desc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌。從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #1
programme.desc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭。變髒是工作的一部分。當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜。

programme.desc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反。在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓。對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #3
programme.desc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季。這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞台。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #4
programme.desc: 座頭鯨回歸阿拉斯加豐饒的食堂,三文魚則回到河流產卵。不過,牠們必須跟飢餓的棕熊討一條生路。

programme.title: 下一站: 緬甸
programme.desc: 《下一站: 緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美、最壯觀的「亞洲遺產」濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #3

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #4

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #5

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #6
programme.desc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯。來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事。是時候告別韋札的家人。

programme.desc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生動物。冬天帶來嚴苛的風暴、苦難和衝突,大多數動物都要為生存而戰。

programme.desc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然。在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸。一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #1
programme.desc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味。他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #2
programme.desc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒。他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #2
programme.desc: 按時序再體驗太陽神13號險些釀成的災難,這是美國太空總署同時最具破壞性和最美好的時刻之一。通過新聞片段、任務控制的音頻和美國太空總署的存檔見證1970年4月的事件。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #3
programme.desc: 通過警察的音頻和視頻,還有當地及國家新聞報道,審 視2002年華盛頓特區的狙擊手襲擊事件。狙擊手為期三週的恐怖統治引發了美國史上最激烈、最複雜的搜捕行動之一。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #4
programme.desc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史。他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程。Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #1

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #4

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 福音電影: 最危險人物
programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天3 誰主生死
programme.desc: 死亡,是每一個人必經階段,但當與死亡直接交鋒的時候,大部份人仍然會手足無措。有見《如果還有明天2》的反應理想,創世電視籌備了特別版,訪問多位醫學界專業人士,分別有香港中文大學醫學教授沈祖堯、精神科醫生莊紹賢透過他們切身之痛的經歷,將見證結合醫學知識,剖析人面對死亡時如何提供深層的安慰,讓

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:你的時間用在那裡? 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

高朋滿座#80粵
programme.desc: 消防員欲破門而入，原來家中傳出不明氣體只是婷不潔的球鞋發出氣味。大廈維修停水停電，眾人上街擔水，缺少運動的眾人均不支。有義、有情及溢滿見勢色不對，竟計劃集體逃亡。可是蕙婷發燒厲害，溢滿取消逃亡行動。

programme.title: 尚食#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 子衿親自送膳，憑口才令皇上留下孟尚食送來的幾道菜。胡尚食準備的炮豚呈現祥瑞圖紋博得皇上歡心，明火卻不慎點燃龍袍。宴席突現刺客，瞻基因護駕不力遭皇上指責。胡尚食自知落敗，邀子衿見面，而後借月華之手自盡。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 手工豆製品買少見少，鼎爺與阿譚到老字號豆品廠，見識豆製品的製作過程。自家製豆漿的豆渣不浪費，鼎爺教路用來配鴨蛋、韭菜等製作「豆香餅」，不妨以豆漿伴吃。鼎爺再以鶴藪、花蛤配搭豆漿炮製菜式，先下花蛤到豆漿中略煮，再加入鶴藪吸收豆漿的鮮甜味。蟬蛻營養豐富，還可用來製作牛腩煲，亦有改善肉質的作用。燜煮菜式宜採用蓮藕的哪部份？注意燜煮技巧以及下材料的次序。鼎爺再以蟬蛻煲「豬腱藥膳湯」，各式藥材有何功效？

programme.title: 才駿Hashtag 南方東英ETF 指南粵
流行都市粵
programme.desc: 太極樂隊成軍四十年，五子到臨錄影廠，暢談巡唱香港站內容及往後的巡唱計劃。合作難免有分歧，他們卻認為成員之間互相欣賞，是眾人可夾Band足四十年的原因！他們更會即席高歌一曲<頂天立地。轉季易令人出現氣管問題，而室內空氣質素低亦可引致不適，室內環境有何通常存在的污染物？使用空氣清新劑，或會令情況適得其反？此外，呼吸系統科醫生亦帶來有助改善家居空氣質素的方法。「睇餸食飯」，三姐奉上「芝麻醋香軟殼蟹」。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 前列腺可以說是中年男士最常面對的問題，50歲以上的男性當中，每10人便有約4人(40%)，情況頗為嚴重。節目這次請來煒烈，細談面對前列腺增生的問題。本集也有泌尿科李卓暉醫生為大家解構何謂「前列腺增生」與箇中成因，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會跟大家分享與前列腺增生相關的食療。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這次到訪零食廠的四位小兵，皆是「廠長話」遊戲的高手，不輕易做多或做漏。Tiffany姐姐加快考核速度，仍未見有人失手，最終會是甚麼指令，讓三人同時被淘汰？走入果園收集水果，要避開障礙物，布甸隊男生摘下水果後，以敏捷身手移動到終點，被指似特務動作！「溶化之橋」任務，啫喱女兵即使手上只有三個雪糕球，仍保持着謹慎穩步節奏，似無失手的可能。布甸隊則按對手成績調整挑戰數量，採「先苦後甜」的策略達到穩勝結果？

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 五十嵐告訴蜻蛉自己過去所犯的錯，希望她不要像自己那樣後悔莫及，加上阿圓奪標的消息，終令蜻蛉下定決心跟五十嵐前往惡礫島。兩人幾經辛苦找到垢多，並獲得對方批准挑戰其設計的高難度球洞。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 色弱是指分辨顏色的能力較正常低，最普遍的是紅綠色弱，少部分患者是藍黃色弱，大多都是先天性的，是透過X染色體去遺傳的，所以男性的病發率比女性高十六倍，如果是後天色弱，有機會是單眼病發，但先天性的就一定是雙眼病發。色弱沒有醫治方法，不過一般對生活影響不大，但可透過特殊鏡片輔助日常生活。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐保險呈獻：準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 女士的裙邊遭扶手電梯卡着，同行友人立即按緊急掣煞停電梯，被批評不顧電梯上其他人的安全。工程師評論按停電梯此舉是否恰當。七旬翁因患上血管瘤，在某醫院接受微創手術。術後，家屬卻發現老翁不能行走，向院方追究下才知手術風險並非術前醫生所言？此外，家屬未曾簽署手術同意書，只曾口頭同意安排，質疑被醫生誤導亦感自責，誓要討回公道。另介紹「智方便」應用程式的安全認證技術，及其在應用層面的發展。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2790粵
programme.desc: 城安、凌凌與壯出席某網友的喪禮，發現家屬對死者並不了解，導致喪禮錯漏百出。城安有感熊家眾人絕不可靠，擔心自己會重複該位網友的情況，於是預先擬定身後事的細節，包括找人照顧科莫多龍小Bon等各種事項。萬事俱備，卻仍欠一事尚未辦妥，凌凌等嘗試幫忙，怎料真的生出「離愁別緒」。熊家眾人察覺城安、凌凌等人有不妥，瑞素此時更意外發現城安整理的葬禮備忘錄。城安得悉眾人憂心他命不久矣，遂將計就計，欲從中得到好處……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#17粵PG
programme.desc: 邵玲以感化官身分為雅文求情，邵文終判雅文「殘酷對待動物」罪成，輕判兩年感化令。及後，惠知當面質疑邵文判刑草率……當晚，邵玲發現雅文的母親開直播怒罵，並持刀威脅雅文。邵玲趕往現場，竟見雅文之母身中多刀垂危。外界紛紛譴責邵文錯放兇手，仕途受阻，使邵玲自責。惠知審理此案，被告雅文辯稱是自衛，法醫卻指不合理，因傷者傷勢嚴重，不符合自衛所需的武力。案件陷入膠着，此時邵玲發現自己的筆記簿有異，揭示另有內情……

programme.title: 大生意人#12粵普
programme.desc: 古平原透過徐三從俄羅斯人手上購入大批軍火並運回安徽，恭親王看見後大喜，更推薦古平原為安撫使，古平原趁機拜託恭親王調查父親的下落。古平原隻身前往合肥城內勸說李成，最後李成答應讓百姓和不願留下的士兵離開…

programme.title: 試真D粵
programme.desc: 美儀姐、朱仔、GM到公園野餐，坐下才叫外賣三文治及飲品，夠休閒！是無人機，還是「騎兵」送餐較快？打開餐點，騎兵的那份餐附加一份細心？六十元人民幣的一人火鍋任飲任食，雖然相宜，惟網上負評連連。牛肉的肉色紅過火龍果，淥完仍一樣紅？蟹柳乍看像擦膠，淥完更「恐怖」？製作組選了一間網上評分49的餐廳去試真D，又可有伏？餐廳附帶表演，連食物都以藝術品形式奉上，而令主持讚不絕口的是其海鮮，縱然消費較高也值得！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵

programme.desc: 簡潔堅決離婚，家聰接簡潔通知辦理分居手續，呆立當場，更在飯堂內不小心被滾湯燙傷送院。國棟問簡潔與家聰情況，簡潔衝口而出要國棟向文靜查究。文靜得悉家聰入院，緊張地趕往醫院，國棟不知就裡，著文靜照顧家聰。文靜與家聰決到外國過新生活，家聰返警署辭職，警署內各人均議論紛紛。國棟返家見字條，發現文靜留下字條，字句中責國棟只埋頭工作，一直備受冷落，故決定離開。簡潔將家聰與文靜的事告知，國棟大受打擊。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#80粵
programme.desc: 消防員欲破門而入，原來家中傳出不明氣體只是婷不潔的球鞋發出氣味。大廈維修停水停電，眾人上街擔水，缺少運動的眾人均不支。有義、有情及溢滿見勢色不對，竟計劃集體逃亡。可是蕙婷發燒厲害，溢滿取消逃亡行動。

programme.title: 尚食#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 子衿親自送膳，憑口才令皇上留下孟尚食送來的幾道菜。胡尚食準備的炮豚呈現祥瑞圖紋博得皇上歡心，明火卻不慎點燃龍袍。宴席突現刺客，瞻基因護駕不力遭皇上指責。胡尚食自知落敗，邀子衿見面，而後借月華之手自盡。

programme.title: 我係小廚神2粵
programme.desc: 十八位參賽小朋友分成六組，在三十分鐘之內炮製自選菜式，拼盡全力在麥潔兒、陳國強、楊國基三位星級評判的手上，爭奪七個出線資格。各小廚神磨刀霍霍，以黑白胡椒蝦、夏威夷漢堡包等菜式迎戰，誰人可以脫穎而出？

香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

programme.desc: 溢在夢中見己化身成孫悟空，更替「唐僧」義打走蜘蛛精。有遇上前任女友，有「蜘蛛精」之稱的智貞來訪。她更向義重提結婚協議。溢與義用盡辦法也不能打消貞的求愛念頭，時溢引發意外，令貞損失億元生意，貞揚言報復。

programme.title: 尚食#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 錦衣衛查明與刺客接頭的中間人是曾跟隨瞻基習武的幼軍士兵，皇上起了疑心，遂派瞻基去南京。子衿讓瞻基施以苦肉計，同時利用這機會假裝不經意盛讚皇上聖明，再大膽進言為建文朝逆臣家眷求情，受皇上賞識，升任司膳。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 阿譚品嚐台式滷水小食後仍然「未夠喉」，鼎爺應拍檔要求帶來更多台式滋味。台式刈包又名「虎咬豬」，從搓麵糰到發酵等步驟，有甚麼要訣？自家製滷肉採用多種調味料，除了撈飯一流，用刈包夾起享用，同樣美味！有機農場內種植了巨型冬瓜，鼎爺分享揀選冬瓜小貼士，還會教煮味道濃郁、消暑補氣的「冬瓜粒鴨湯」。將冬瓜打泥，加入片糖慢慢煮勻成冬瓜糖之後，便可隨時加水煲出「冬瓜茶」。自製冬瓜糖雖然做法不難，但講求時間與耐性！

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 眼睛血管阻塞或會引致「眼中風」，眼科醫生提醒年紀較大、三高人士、吸煙者是風險較高族群，病徵為突發視力模糊。這病現時以黃斑針治療為主，醫生亦詳述此針劑的相關資訊與注意事項。心肌肥厚最常見由高血壓形成，有機會導致患者出現心律問題，甚至猝死，不容忽視！心臟科醫生細說診治資訊，並提醒大眾如出現心悸、胸悶等徵兆，應及早求醫。「睇餸食飯」環節，小儀師傅示範一道「沙茶牛頸脊粉絲煲」，香濃惹味。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 糖尿病是中老年人常見病症之一，近年更有年輕化的跡象，情況值得關注。《醫度講》這集請來馮盈盈，由於其母親有輕微糖尿，令她對糖尿病亦十分關心。本集有胡依諾醫生為大家解構何謂「糖尿病」與箇中的分類，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會跟大家分享糖尿病的食療。

programme.desc: 大四喜與雷公相爭，欲提升「人氣」，家聰提議大四喜與力王、群姐合作。力王因不想分心唱歌而推託，敢佳卻發現網上有他與群姐合唱的新MV。原來群姐因某些原因利用AI生成影片，並被人上載網絡。力王堅決不肯合唱，敢威遂找Ivan以AI代勞。大四喜、群姐與AI力王的合唱MV大受歡迎，力王以侵權為由要求影片下架卻不果，聲言要提控敢威，父子不歡而散。敢威本欲與力王和好，怎料力王竟將事情鬧大，敢威遂決意與他「相鬥」……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#18粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知的存疑揭出犯案真相，邵玲自覺辜負雅文而愧疚，惠知的說話，讓她回顧童年與母親的關係。邵文憶起跟雅晴的甜蜜點滴，才意識已動真情，並向她道歉，但雅晴只願做回朋友。郊野發現一焦屍，四名少年被捕。惠知懷疑是謀殺，惟屍體損毀嚴重，無法證實死因，只能控以非法處理屍體罪。案件開審，控方錯漏百出，讓辯方淑樺有機可乘，提出釋放被告之一張景翔。惠知態度強硬，拒絕淑樺要求……惠知為審案選擇延後手術，令案件產生變數……

programme.title: 大生意人#13粵普PG
programme.desc: 喬松把投誠義軍暫時安置到北營，但入夜後卻殺死他們，平原覺得是自己害死他們，而李成和依梅被生擒活捉；平原求紫軒幫忙去找九帥，只有九帥能把李成和依梅救出來；李成勸義軍不要再打仗，說完這番話就拔劍自刎而死。

programme.title: 試真D粵PG
programme.desc: 有恐懼就要面對！GM自言一直怕蟲，廣州有餐廳提供「多蟲」選擇，每當蟲蟲上枱，GM都似乎想把菜式移開！一隻「身價高」的桂花蟬，何以令他反應奇大？朱仔亦因某乳鴿店老闆娘的凌厲眼神而恐懼，據指有湯店女店主是練習吵架的好對手，朱仔能否藉這趟探店撫平創傷？經過了解，湯店老闆娘「有性格」，原來出於顧及食物衛生的苦衷。美儀姐往找醫師把脈，其實是為了一個專屬火鍋湯底。「菇有菇味」食評絕非講笑，更值得給予店家滿分！

programme.desc: 簡潔收拾心情重投工作。國棟知文靜與家聰準備離港，到機場找二人，甫見家聰，即怒打他一場，文靜維護家聰並向國棟承認早已變心，國棟傷心。時楊光看見一切，國棟要楊光將事件保密。國棟悲痛下找家中各人發洩，妹國寶、弟國樑及兄國富均為目標。國棟寄情工作，遂命下屬加緊整理未完的工作，各人均吃不消。國棟與文靜離婚的消息，瞬間傳遍整個差館，國棟以為是楊光所為。楊光將首次談判成功的經歷，傳送上談判小組網頁與組員分享。

高朋滿座#82粵
programme.desc: 溢看到滿身血跡的義和拿刀的智貞，欲救人時卻滑倒地上。溢醒過來後竟「時光倒流」，他以為是上天給他拯救家人的機會。可惜幾番努力仍不得要領，反令貞認定溢來作弄她，貞怒極詛咒高家眾人要死！溢欲將家人強留在家。

programme.title: 尚食#22粵普
programme.desc: 子衿為躲避彭城伯夫人逃到書房，瞻基一邊為她掩護，一邊諷刺她機心重。皇上進食時突感不適，太子妃質疑八珍糕有問題，子衿冷靜地解釋。皇上欣賞子衿的聰慧，正要獎賞，皇后突然言明子衿的身分，提議冊封她為太子嬪。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 阿譚不吝嗇地拿出A5和牛，並分享正確的解凍步驟。阿爺卻選用水晶梨與甜豆，再以中式方法烹調和牛？和牛油脂多，炒煮時仍要加少許油，有何原因？鼎爺豪氣地用兩斤雞項，炮製更濃味的「豆豉雞煲」回敬阿譚。豆豉預先炸過不易溶化，而整個過程不加水，上枱前還有灒酒一步，滋味更濃！二人到唐餅店見識皮蛋酥的工序後，回到廚房自製「酥脆蛋散」。很多食物都是熱食才美味，蛋散卻不宜趁熱品嚐；而麵糰的搓揉及發酵時間亦要好好掌握。

programme.title: 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 醫學上縱無法根治柏金遜症，但可減慢病情惡化。神經科醫生細說此症成因與病徵，也會概述臨床診斷方法。早期柏金遜症患者，可按不同症狀服用對應藥物，晚期患者又可怎樣治療？兩位肝癌康復者到來受訪，提到接受肝臟移植手術後仿如「重生」，並加入相關義工團體，向同路人分享經驗。此外，團體每年舉辦名為「重生盃」的羽毛球比賽，推廣器官捐贈。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨炮製一道「新鮮菠蘿炒飯」，菠蘿要新鮮，再加海鮮夠美味！

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 高血壓是常見健康問題之一，本港15歲或以上人士約兩成七患有高血壓，而75歲或以上患高血壓的比率超過七成三，情況值得關注。這次請來對高血壓十分關心的支嚳儀，本集亦有胡依諾醫生為大家解構高血壓問題，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會在節目中跟大家分享高血壓的食療與降壓穴位。

programme.title: 五味人生#14粵PG
programme.desc: 若嵐被永禎嚇暈，醒後回復所有記憶；但無法想通雙春為何不離開，反而苦苦支撐酒樓及關家。飛揚要九妹煮出五碟同樣的菜式，指當中暗藏一個課題。九妹請眾人幫忙，雙春讓九妹明白自己的味覺出現問題，只得請雙春陪他求醫……雙春在發悶氣，永禎向她坦言說出九暗戀她。勝天把戲票連汽車及保鏢也借給永禎「會佳人」，永禎卻被誤認是勝天而遭綁架；飛揚竟決定不付贖金。雙春與九妹與綁匪見面，希望他們釋放永禎，九妹與對方大打出手……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 為了幫助大家強化心肺功能，兒童體適能教練於「WORKOUT 2GETHER」教做碎步跑、抬腿，再繞着地下的飛碟跑圈，然後邊走邊跳。喘氣反應實屬正常，最後以伸展動作完成整套鍛練，舒展一下肌肉。第二輪的訓練則針對手眼協調及平衡力，拋高豆袋，專注留意豆袋的動向去接住，再加上拍手、二人拋接等元素，難度與趣味大增。嘗試將豆袋放於頭頂，眼望前方走動，也可考驗平衡力。另播放《河馬與小鳥》的AI生成動畫下半部。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 第五次偶像公主大賽突然拍板舉行。假若Quartet STAR勝出，就能救回阿紡，但假若由暗黑千依勝出，Quartet STAR就會跟阿紡一樣被囚禁。面對這個危險的對決，阿櫻四人仍然態度堅決，令陽葵很想知道她們強大的秘密。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 香港的豬場數目，由七十年代的四千多戶，不斷縮減，直至現在只餘下四十多個，本地養豬業，是否走向末路呢？新聞掏寶和大家重溫2005年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2792粵
programme.desc: 吳旺達贊助拍攝短劇，期間生出事端，Bonnie為救城安甘代其受罰，幸此時遇到嫻姐，獲她出面調解。Bonnie將與蔥頭之母會面，本憂心她難相處，及後知悉對方是嫻姐，便感鬆一口氣。嫻姐卻提出要Bonnie與蔥頭分手，原來嫻姐認為她與城安糾纏不清。城安後來在片場遇到嫻姐，本欲避嫌，但事與願違。城安為讓嫻姐相信他已與Bonnie撇清關係，付出不少努力，並因某人之故，事情越鬧越大，Bonnie卻發現不妥……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#19粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知向光正隱瞞病情，堅持完成審理「焦屍案」才接受手術。淑樺代表景翔，自信他可無罪獲釋。惟審訊期間，另一被告關勝輝轉為污點證人，供出景翔是團夥的首領……真相逐步揭出，惠知卻因病不支昏倒在庭上，案件轉由邵文接手審理。淑樺突然提出景翔的不在場證明，揭示他雖然就案發當日的行蹤說謊，但背後另有苦衷。最終，邵文以專業態度處理眼前證據，持平地審理案件……沒人想到，景翔有恃無恐，竟與網友一同策劃更瘋狂的遊戲。

programme.title: 大生意人#14粵普PG
programme.desc: 九帥要帶走李成的屍體，依梅情急之下昏倒，平原把依梅帶回家，但她一直昏迷不醒。胡老太爺著急地找平原幫忙，原來之前平原惹惱了萬堂，萬堂和外國茶商約定，一兩安徽茶都不許買，令安徽茶出口海外的銷路全部斷掉。

programme.title: 試真D粵
programme.desc: 另類配搭的壽司逐一試，蔓越莓開心果牛肉獲美儀姐、朱仔好評；山楂扣肉、芋泥口味奇怪，GM還初嚐豬腦，反應令人意外！三水臭屁醋臭出名堂，以此湯底打邊爐，只有零次或無限次？朱仔出動鼻塞、口罩進店，卻吃不停……衣服殘留氣味好難頂，用餐後要緊急處理。88元人民幣蒸巨蠔勁「新鮮」，上菜一刻仍見抖動？開蠔區有蒼蠅飛過，傳菜升降機竟兼運垃圾；朱仔、GM被嚇怕，竟想撇低美儀姐離場……經歷「生死」過後，一致畀零分！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#12粵
programme.desc: 雜誌社記者採訪談判小組，國棟一再叮囑組員要慎言，免將談判機密洩露。記者Joe對楊光首次勸服事主的個案感興趣，遂追問詳情。訪問完畢，卻意外發現組員忠耀遺下的機密文件。國棟責楊光洩漏資料，楊光感屈辱，一怒辭去談判工作。可人往報館找Joe對質，Joe承認是根據拾獲的機密文件描述事件，絕非楊光外洩資料。國棟知錯怪楊光並誠意挽留楊光，但楊光不為所動。可人漸對楊光產生好感，到處搜尋楊光喜歡的襟章送贈。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 醫學上縱無法根治柏金遜症，但可減慢病情惡化。神經科醫生細說此症成因與病徵，也會概述臨床診斷方法。早期柏金遜症患者，可按不同症狀服用對應藥物，晚期患者又可怎樣治療？兩位肝癌康復者到來受訪，提到接受肝臟移植手術後仿如「重生」，並加入相關義工團體，向同路人分享經驗。此外，團體每年舉辦名為「重生盃」的羽毛球比賽，推廣器官捐贈。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨炮製一道「新鮮菠蘿炒飯」，菠蘿要新鮮，再加海鮮夠美味！

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 高血壓是常見健康問題之一，本港15歲或以上人士約兩成七患有高血壓，而75歲或以上患高血壓的比率超過七成三，情況值得關注。這次請來對高血壓十分關心的支嚳儀，本集亦有胡依諾醫生為大家解構高血壓問題，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會在節目中跟大家分享高血壓的食療與降壓穴位。

programme.title: 五味人生#14粵PG
programme.desc: 若嵐被永禎嚇暈，醒後回復所有記憶；但無法想通雙春為何不離開，反而苦苦支撐酒樓及關家。飛揚要九妹煮出五碟同樣的菜式，指當中暗藏一個課題。九妹請眾人幫忙，雙春讓九妹明白自己的味覺出現問題，只得請雙春陪他求醫……雙春在發悶氣，永禎向她坦言說出九暗戀她。勝天把戲票連汽車及保鏢也借給永禎「會佳人」，永禎卻被誤認是勝天而遭綁架；飛揚竟決定不付贖金。雙春與九妹與綁匪見面，希望他們釋放永禎，九妹與對方大打出手……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#82粵
programme.desc: 溢看到滿身血跡的義和拿刀的智貞，欲救人時卻滑倒地上。溢醒過來後竟「時光倒流」，他以為是上天給他拯救家人的機會。可惜幾番努力仍不得要領，反令貞認定溢來作弄她，貞怒極詛咒高家眾人要死！溢欲將家人強留在家。

programme.title: 尚食#22粵普
programme.desc: 子衿為躲避彭城伯夫人逃到書房，瞻基一邊為她掩護，一邊諷刺她機心重。皇上進食時突感不適，太子妃質疑八珍糕有問題，子衿冷靜地解釋。皇上欣賞子衿的聰慧，正要獎賞，皇后突然言明子衿的身分，提議冊封她為太子嬪。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 世上最臭的食物有多恐怖？農夫以行動告知！台灣有何獨特形式吃臭豆腐？同時設自助洗衣區及咖啡店的三藩市小店，為何晚上才吸引顧客？馬國明、陳煒絞盡腦汁回答一系列問題，還一同欣賞曼谷大師的「Do姐肖像果雕」。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 安德尊的出現，令大廳出現濃濃火藥味！Do姐、薛家燕兩位阿姐如何應對？陸永還嚷着想與大王割席，到底發生了甚麼事？今集問題與東京「站起」的天婦羅、曼谷窩夫高塔、台北蛋糕大師有關，過程發現大王的一連串缺點！

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 機械城足球隊(完)
programme.desc: 每天放學後，機器人艾力都會和朋友們在森林公園的小足球場一起踢足球。有人內向，有人天才，有人愛搞怪，各式各樣的人集結成一支很棒的隊伍，展開一段熱血青春的足球故事。

programme.title: 夢怪護衛隊
programme.desc: 納喬和家人在一個夜晚搬進新城鎮，面對新家、新學校，一切都充滿未知的恐懼，而他的房間也藏著祕密：一群神秘又難以捉摸的怪物。但當噩夢來臨時，他們會成為最可靠的夥伴。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.desc: 每天放學後，機器人艾力都會和朋友們在森林公園的小足球場一起踢足球。有人內向，有人天才，有人愛搞怪，各式各樣的人集結成一支很棒的隊伍，展開一段熱血青春的足球故事。

programme.title: 夢怪護衛隊
programme.desc: 納喬和家人在一個夜晚搬進新城鎮，面對新家、新學校，一切都充滿未知的恐懼，而他的房間也藏著祕密：一群神秘又難以捉摸的怪物。但當噩夢來臨時，他們會成為最可靠的夥伴。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Sima's Song
programme.desc: In 1970s Afghanistan, best friends Suraya and Sima are torn apart by political upheaval. Suraya is a wealthy communist and Sima is a traditional singer, and though their paths diverge, their enduring bond proves stronger than ideology.

programme.title: 15 Years
programme.desc: After being wrongfully imprisoned for 15 years, piano prodigy Jenny meets Syrian refugee Omar and agrees to accompany him on a talent show. There, Jenny faces the man who framed her and her ex, and she must choose between vengeance and happiness.

programme.title: Almost Entirely A Slight Disaster

programme.title: For A Moment, Forever
programme.desc: A young popstar overwhelmed by fame meets a troubled ex-rocker teaching music to adolescents at a therapy centre. Both longing for love, they get closer as affection for music connects them, but shall they overcome the burdens of his past?

programme.title: Man And A Baby
programme.desc: Dad (Antti) is left alone with a newborn after the mom (Pia) decides motherhood is not her thing. Single dad tries to survive alone in "women's world" and keep the baby and himself alive.

programme.title: With or Without you
programme.desc: A young woman, her free-spirited mother and a West African man find themselves on an unexpected road trip that leads to emotional transformation.

programme.title: A Childhood
programme.desc: As summer drags by, 13-year-old Jimmy, forced by circumstance to become an adult too soon, runs up against the limits of his small hometown and his turbulent life, caught between a mother on the slide and a stepfather who keeps her down.

programme.title: Cloud Under The Roof
programme.desc: Paul, Julia, and Lilly are a happy family, until Julia dies unexpectedly. For the sake of his daughter, Paul wants to function and suppress his grief. Lilly keeps challenging him with her imagination and her very own view of Mum's death.

programme.title: Sima's Song
programme.desc: In 1970s Afghanistan, best friends Suraya and Sima are torn apart by political upheaval. Suraya is a wealthy communist and Sima is a traditional singer, and though their paths diverge, their enduring bond proves stronger than ideology.

programme.title: Under the Volcano
programme.desc: A blended Ukrainian family spends the last day of their vacation in Tenerife, Spain, when suddenly Russia’s ongoing occupation of Ukraine turns into a full-scale invasion. As their return to Kyiv becomes impossible, the tourists become refugees overnight.

programme.title: Backwards
programme.desc: Inspired by true events. The story of a young mother of an autistic boy, whose many years of stubbornness and the fight against bureaucracy and human heartlessness led to changes in the education system.

programme.title: The Salvation Of The World As We Know It
programme.desc: After a suicide attempt, 17-year-old Paul is sent to a psychiatric centre by his father. There, he encounters other youths with issues just like him, one of whom is Toni.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman enters a gambler's apartment to find four shackles hanging from his ceiling to aid in kinky activities.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the "Tsai Li Fu" style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancee enlists a swordsman-who secretly loves her-to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp;amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people to the Qing officials and recruits fighters from all backgrounds. Members from Wudan and Ermei are the first to yield and collude with local bullies. When they start attacking the Shaolin Monastery, its most famous disciples have to band together and fight against the enemies.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Feng Yu Song Chun Gui - EP14
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Global Business

Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: The World Today

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. programme.title: Asia Today

programme.title: Global Business

programme.title: First Blood (S1) - Anthony Sowell: The Cleveland Strangler
programme.desc: African-American women in the Mt Pleasant neighbourhood of Cleveland were vanishing. Their families cried for help, but no one knew what was happening. No one except Anthony Sowell.

programme.title: First Blood (S1) - Richard Ramirez: The Nightstalker
programme.desc: Richard Ramirez terrorised Southern California in the mid-1980s, and anyone could be a target. Growing up yearning for a father figure, he found mentorship with his sadistic cousin.

programme.title: Interrogation Raw (S3) - Broken Brotherhood
programme.desc: A home invasion results in a man being beaten to death and set on fire. As investigators race to find the perpetrator, a shocking 911 call pits two brothers against each other in the interrogation room.

programme.title: Tell Me How I Died - Out Of Reach
programme.desc: What begins as an open-and-shut case spins into a full-on investigation when a mother and son are found dead in their home. Was this a murdersuicide, or could someone else have been responsible?

programme.title: Accused: Guilty Or Innocent? (S3) - Angry Shooter Or Hammer Attack Defense?
programme.desc: After police respond to a shooting in Chicago, a man is arrested and charged. He claims that he was attacked with a hammer before reaching for his weapon.

programme.title: Murder In The 21st - The Brutal Truth
programme.desc: A brutal attack on two employees of a high-end shop leaves one woman dead and another scarred by the memory of the events she survived.

programme.title: Drug Runner Lover
programme.desc: After investigating a drug smuggler for years, police finally receive information that leads to his arrest but he refuses to talk. Police have just 8 hours to identify, locate and arrest the entire ring.

programme.title: Interrogation Raw (S2) - The Missing Priest
programme.desc: The search for a missing priest leads detectives on a multi-state manhunt for a suspect who may be the only person with the answers to his whereabouts.

programme.title: Interrogation Raw (S2) - A Lover's Betrayal
programme.desc: After the dismembered remains of a missing woman are found in a freezer, investigators uncover a love triangle and a murderous conspiracy to conceal the truth.

programme.title: Beyond The Headlines: The Series - Dark Influences
programme.desc: Shocking first-hand accounts of people who were manipulated, abused, and finally broke free before it was too late. We'll hear from former members of Gwen Shamblin's Remnant Fellowship, and more.

programme.title: My Strange Arrest (S1) - Hanging On The Hood
programme.desc: A man hangs on the hood of his car while his ex-girlfriend drives it on the highway. An intoxicated woman flees from airport police on a motorised suitcase; and more.

programme.title: My Strange Arrest (S2) - Serial Wedding Crasher
programme.desc: A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country: a 911 call about cold fries leads to an arrest for murder; a fugitive is caught on the toilet; and more!

programme.title: Sleeping With A Killer (S2) - Ryan Poster
programme.desc: After a woman calls 911 to report shooting her boyfriend in self-defence, investigators uncover a pristine crime scene and disturbing behaviour that cast doubt on her story.

programme.title: Lie Detector: Truth Or Deception - Matheau Moore
programme.desc: Matheau Moore sits down for a polygraph test with former FBI agent George Olivo. Though he was found not guilty of murdering his wife, suspicions still follow him-even among those closest to the case.

programme.title: Tell Me How I Died - Locked Away
programme.desc: During a welfare check, authorities discover a man has been living with the mummified bodies of his family. Pathologists cannot determine if they died naturally or if something nefarious occurred.

programme.title: Hoarders (S14) - Marjorie (Part B)
programme.desc: Marjorie's husband, Irv, has recently been diagnosed with Parkinson's Disease and has already taken two dangerous falls in the house where the EMTs could not get to him.

Tony and his team are introduced to the other cool SH1FT3R racers, and while they can’t stop the heist without blowing their cover, they do manage to get a tracker on the train car Shashi and Layla stole.

She digs and she digs and she digs.... until she finds total quiet. Tales from Africa.

Squirrel is too busy braiding her tail to join in, but when she finally realises that there is not enough food to go round she races around gathering nuts for all the animals. The thing is she can't stop! Tales from Africa.
